description: Node.js and TypeScript knowledge skills: review criteria, security guide, Jest/Vitest patterns, and JSDoc standards.

queries.query: Review src/services/orders.ts for async/await mistakes and unhandled promise rejections.
Our Express routes mix callbacks and promises. Review routes/ for Node.js best-practice issues.
Look at this TypeScript module and tell me where we're abusing `any` and non-null assertions.
Review this Node module for performance problems: synchronous fs calls in request handlers and N+1 database queries.
Audit the Express API for injection: we pass req.query straight into a MongoDB find and into child_process.exec.
Could the regex in validators/email.js cause ReDoS? Check the rest of the validators while you're at it.
Harden our Node service: we merge user JSON into config with lodash.merge, and jsonwebtoken accepts alg none.
Check package-lock.json and our code for dependency security problems and prototype pollution.
Write Vitest tests for formatPrice in src/utils/money.ts and cover the rounding edge cases.
How do I mock fetch in Jest for a module that calls it at import time?
tests/parser.test.ts is full of copy-pasted cases. Convert it to test.each.
Add JSDoc to every exported function in lib/client.js, with @param and @returns.
Audit the doc comments in our TypeScript SDK. Which exported types are undocumented?
Which JSDoc tags should I use for a function that returns a Promise and can throw?
Upgrade this project from Node 20 to Node 22 in .nvmrc and the package.json engines field.
Write pytest tests for api/views.py.
What's the difference between == and === in JavaScript?
Add an npm script that runs eslint --fix.
Review this Go handler for goroutine leaks.
Center this div with flexbox.
